## Notes

### Quick read
- Arie is a long-haired blonde mom of at least three little boys (youngest about 10 to 14 months) who makes relatable real-life videos (kitchen, errands at the store); one of Fatima's stated favourites, with the best ROAS in this batch (1.82) from just 2 videos.
- Best next move: deliver the ideas Fatima promised on Sep 22 "in about 24-48 hours" (due around Sep 24); she is finishing other brand collabs and wants to go long term with Bambora.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- Who she is on camera: mom, long wavy blonde hair, athleisure (pink tank, biker shorts) or light tank and jeans with sandals. Kids: a blond baby or young toddler boy (about 10 to 14 months) who rides in the sling, plus two older blond boys (roughly 3 and 5) at the store. Settings: a small home kitchen and nursery, and a big box store clothing aisle with a trolley. Sling is light blue with the mandala strap.
- Format: (1) talking head with punchy word-by-word captions (bfd1ca39, 34s) that holds up her old complicated carriers and manual, then demos putting on the sling in the kitchen; (2) text-overlay errand vlog (6d0e1b61, 51s, no voiceover transcribed) where she puts the sling on mid-shop, lifts the toddler in, and keeps shopping with the other boys in the trolley.
- Hooks (quote): "I avoided baby carriers for an embarrassingly dumb reason. Every baby carrier I've owned comes with a manual and I somehow still can't ever figure out how to put them on."; text "The one thing I always bring when I run errands with my kids."
- What worked: bfd1ca39 ("Love it!! Thank you so much") ran as 3 ads; 6d0e1b61 ran as 1 ad. $124 earnings, $1,035 GMV, ROAS 1.82. The self-deprecating "embarrassingly dumb reason" hook plus the old carriers pile is a great comparison opener.
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - bfd1ca39 (running as 3 ads): at about 30s she is doing dishes with both hands (lifting a pot lid) and no hand on the baby; the script says "I no longer have to choose between doing dishes or holding him". That is a hands-free implication and breaks check 2. Worth flagging to the media buyer.
  - 6d0e1b61 (running): at 26s she lifts the toddler in with the other kids nearby; at 35s one hand on him, seat under his bottom. At 44s wide shot pushing the trolley, hand on baby not clearly visible.
  - Buckle closed in the close ups; safety loop not clearly visible.
- Strengths to lean on: relatable, funny, honest mom voice; multi-kid errand chaos; the comparison with old carriers.
- To improve: keep one hand on baby in every task shot; replace "doing dishes" with arm and back relief language.
